HOW 6 AREA TYPES ARE FORMED
One simple headline only — raw signals stay underneath
City Near / Gap / Far is a modifier, never a stop rule.
1Tourism NodeTourism destination YES within 3 km using strict destination evidence.
2Commercial HubMarket / commercial anchor within 1 km.
3Education CatchmentSchool within 1 km, if no stronger anchor above.
4Mobility NodeMajor road within 2 km or public transport within 1 km.
5Residential CatchmentResidential / building catchment exists without stronger anchor.
6Peripheral / UnanchoredNo strong anchor detected yet.
Contoh: Far City + Market 180 m + Major Road 420 m + Dense Residential → headline Commercial Hub. Modifier Far City · Major Corridor · Dense Residential tetap disimpan dan ikut comparison.

WAY OF THINKING · visible logic, not black box

How the engine builds one outlet fingerprint

Semua signal dihitung independen dulu. Baru setelah itu engine bikin 1 headline Area Type supaya gampang dibaca. Jadi simplification di UI tidak membuang evidence.

1Urban PositionNear / Gap / Far city. Tidak menghentikan signal lain.
2AccessibilityMajor road, transport, Valhalla actual access.
3Demand GeneratorsMarket, school, tourism, commercial activity.
4CatchmentResidential land-use + building density.
5Area Type + Modifiers6 headline types only; details remain underneath.
6Performance TestCarton, high-volume rate, combination, island consistency.
Urban Position
Position relative to city

Java: Near ≤3km, Gap 3–10km, Far >10km. Non-Java: Near ≤5km, Gap 5–25km, Far >25km.

Accessibility

Major-road straight distance, corridor status, public transport, then optional Valhalla actual route.

Local activity anchors

Market, school, tourism, commercial activity. Multiple anchors may coexist.

Catchment
Residential demand surface

Residential land-use + building count / built-up coverage around 1 km.

00 · CONTEXT SANITY CHECK

Before asking why, where are our outlets today?

Empat context block yang kita sengaja bentuk dibaca dulu sebagai portfolio landscape. Setiap parameter punya distribution + performance sanity check sebelum dipakai untuk menjelaskan high-volume.

Waiting enrichment
Area context belum dihitung. Klik Enrich Area Context. Raw outlet sudah cukup—nggak perlu menunggu nearest-POI scraping selesai.
01 Concentration→02 Difference→03 Evidence→04 Distance→05 Road→06 Residential→07 Combination→08 Area Type→09 Geography→10 Conclusion
01 · DEFINE THE PRIZE

How concentrated is carton today?

Sebelum membahas area, kita pastikan dulu seberapa terkonsentrasi business result-nya. Kalau high-volume outlet memang hanya sebagian kecil tetapi membawa carton besar, baru masuk akal mencari environment yang membedakan mereka.

Next questionKalau outlet besar berbeda secara sales, apakah context di sekitarnya juga berbeda?
02 · FIND WHAT DIFFERS

What is different around high-volume outlets?

Bandingkan prevalence setiap signal di seluruh outlet vs high-volume outlet. Gap terbesar menjadi hipotesis pertama—bukan otomatis sebab.

Next questionGap prevalence menarik, tapi apakah signal itu juga membawa perbedaan carton dan konsisten lintas geography?
03 · BUILD THE EVIDENCE

Which signals deserve deeper investigation?

Tidak ada opaque score. Setiap signal dilihat dari tiga evidence yang transparan: prevalence gap, median carton uplift, dan island consistency.

Next questionKalau signal terlihat menarik, seberapa dekat / seberapa intens context itu harus ada sampai performance berubah?
04 · TEST THE THRESHOLD

Does proximity actually matter?

Gunakan distance-response, bukan threshold assumption. Dot = median; whisker = P25–P75; n selalu terlihat. Signal default mengikuti evidence yang paling layak ditest tetapi tetap bisa diganti di toolbar.

Next questionUntuk accessibility, straight-line distance belum tentu sama dengan actual road access. Apa yang bisa kita baca sekarang tanpa menunggu Valhalla?
05 · TEST ACCESSIBILITY

Does road accessibility separate stronger outlets?

Story tidak pernah menunggu Valhalla. Default memakai major-road distance yang sudah tersedia. Bila Valhalla punya sample cukup, visual otomatis upgrade ke actual road-access view.

Next questionAccessibility menjelaskan movement. Sekarang cek demand catchment: apakah kepadatan residential ikut mengubah profile carton?
06 · TEST THE CATCHMENT

How does residential density relate to carton?

Built-up coverage diperlakukan sebagai continuous context. Quintile dipakai untuk sanity check agar kita bisa melihat gradient, plateau, atau bahkan tidak ada pattern.

Next questionSatu signal mungkin tidak cukup. Apakah dua context bersama-sama terlihat lebih kuat daripada masing-masing secara terpisah?
07 · TEST INTERACTIONS

Which combinations are worth checking?

2×2 interaction matrix membandingkan No/Yes context. Kita tunjukkan observed median, high-volume rate, sample, dan simple additive expectation—tanpa menyebut causality.

Next questionPattern mulai kompleks. Bisa nggak kita simplify menjadi sedikit Area Type tanpa membuang underlying evidence?
08 · SIMPLIFY WITHOUT LOSING EVIDENCE

How do the six Area Types actually perform?

Range plot menunjukkan P25–P75 + median, bukan average bar. High-volume rate dan sample tetap di kanan supaya aggregate tidak menipu.

Next questionApakah pattern tadi benar-benar cukup broad, atau sebenarnya hanya didorong satu pulau?
09 · CHALLENGE THE PATTERN

Is the strongest signal geographically consistent?

Per island kita bandingkan median outlet dengan signal vs baseline island. Hanya island dengan sample cukup yang dipakai untuk consistency read.

Where are these outlets?Visual proof berikutnya adalah geography, bukan chart tambahan.
Final questionSetelah semua evidence, apa yang data saat ini benar-benar suggest—dan apa yang belum boleh kita claim?
10 · CONCLUDE, THEN AUDIT

What does the data currently suggest?

Conclusion dibuat dari evidence yang sudah lewat di atas. Bukan black-box recommendation dan bukan causal claim.

1. What does a big outlet look like?

Compare seberapa sering context muncul di seluruh outlet vs di outlet high-volume.

2. Area Type Performance

Cuma 6 headline type. Rank by median carton, sample size dan 300+ rate tetap kelihatan.

3. Distance → Performance

Validasi apakah threshold proximity kita masuk akal dari actual carton pattern.

4. Road & Accessibility

Major-road proximity + Valhalla actual route access bila sudah dihitung.

5. Residential Density

Bandingkan Low / Medium / High building density dengan carton dan 300+ rate.

6. Combination Matrix

Primary Area Type × modifier. Ini mencari apakah kombinasi context lebih kuat daripada signal tunggal.

7. Archetype Leaderboard

Interesting combination hanya ditampilkan kalau sample cukup.

8. Management Readout

Bahasa bisnis sederhana: pattern apa yang menonjol dan apa yang harus dicek ke lapangan.

9. Island Consistency

Cek apakah pattern kuat secara nasional atau sebenarnya hanya didorong satu pulau.

3. High-volume lens Click row → outlet list

4. Island comparison Click heatmap cell → outlet list
